items.title: Deshaun Watson: Likely inactive Sunday
items.text:
Watson (concussion) is expected to be inactive for Sunday's game at New Orleans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Not expected to return Sunday
items.text:
Monangai (thumb/toe) isn't slated to play in Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, but he's expected to return after the Bears' Week 10 bye in a Week 11 matchup with the Saints, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Plans to return this season
items.text:
Jackson, who is scheduled to undergo surgery on his injured right thumb, has told teammates he plans to return later this season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Expected to return Sunday
items.text:
Egbuka (foot), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Chicago, is slated to return to action, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: In line to play Sunday
items.text:
St. Brown (ribs) is slated to play in Sunday's game at Miami, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
